headline: After two days and four new data sources (earnings, premarket, options, news) that carry size but not direction, day 3 shifts the main effort to execution on setups that already make money before costs.
bullets: News headlines (NEWSDIR) closed: by 09:50 their direction is already in the gap.
FAMC (after-close earnings fade) starts tomorrow as a journal-only shadow; first names ALC and RGTI; nightly data and pre-open checks in place.
Compass size-line spec is ready for the main session (research/pvscale/NOTES.md); COMPCAL still awaits the owner.
Day-3 plan: compare lab vs real paper costs for 14 setups that are positive before costs, then test limit entries at the signal price on their 2-year lists.
One direction pilot a day continues (next: gaps with no news behind them).
next: Observer: lab vs live cost per setup; Builder: FAMC nightly + limit-entry plan; Scout: unexplained-gap pilot.
